linked.title: Linked plots
linked.caption: Two views with linked x ranges.
linked.description: Pass one shared object to linkInfo and choose the bounds to synchronize. Here both plots share xmin and xmax, while keeping separate y ranges.

themes.title: Themes
themes.caption: Open the code and uncomment a theme to compare colors and fonts.
themes.description: Three hotAndReady charts share the same theme. Uncomment a theme assignment near the top of the JavaScript. The automatic layout keeps labels and spacing sized for each chart; explicit settings can override it.
